inputs.text:
Open your eyes and look past the scripted lies they are feeding the public. They want us to swallow the fairy tale that it was just a spontaneous "No Kings" rally that got out of hand, but it is all a synchronized script orchestrated by elite coordinators pulling the invisible strings behind the scenes. 

They deliberately engineered this chaos and staged the resistance precisely to justify the deployment of federal officers with tear gas. This is a calculated psychological operation to condition the public into accepting total control and obedience through manufactured volatility. 

Look at how they try to downplay the true scale of their coordinated crackdown, conveniently admitting to only at least 13 arrests across places like Portland, Denver and... to hide the massive operation underneath. They create the disorder themselves, then blame the crowds to push their hidden agenda. Do not buy the official lie.
